_comment: aterm VTE-MARKS baseline: per corpus, the best sample's MiB per 10^9 performance-core cycles (cycles per instruction on P-cores times all instructions, from the kernel's per-core-type counters) of four 16 MiB mark-heavy corpora (NFD Latin diacritics; Hindi and Thai signs; Korean in conjoining jamo; emoji with VS16, skin tones, ZWJ sequences and flags), each replayed into a fresh live session's Terminal::process at 120x40 in 16 KiB slices by vte_engine_harness. BIGGER-IS-BETTER; the lane runs unadmitted at the load it finds, so cycles are what is judged. Re-record with targo --unverified verify perf --record vte-marks.
